'''Crescent Crossing''' was one of two bridges that joined the [[Crescent Canyon Mesa]] to the rest of the [[Whiterock Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], spanning [[Crescent Canyon]] to link the southern part of the mesa to the foothills of [[Dour Mountain]].
